It's an unsettling trend, but there's little reason to believe the former...

He was the only running back to see a carry for Arizona. From a volume standpoint, he'll be an RB2 play next week against the Rams if Knight remains sidelined.

news.analysis: Higgins did not see a ton of targets Sunday, but made the most of his opportunities by hauling in two touchdowns. Higgins has found the end zone in three straight games, including back-to-back multi-touchdown performances. Higgins and the Bengals will look to continue that momentum against the Steelers in Week 10.

Higgins finished with five catches on six targets for 32 yards and 20.2 PPR points in Cincinnati's 34-17 Week 9 win.
